from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def mk(fam):

        X=np.column_stack([np.sqrt(T), T**3/(1+p[2]*eps), fam(p)])
        coef=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
        return X@coef-sigma
    return f
